note: Floorwalker demo film. `text` is the caption (and the .srt line), `spoken` is what the voice says. `at` = earliest start in seconds from the scene start.

lines.text: One hidden sentence in an email can send $150 to a stranger.
lines.spoken: One hidden sentence in an email can send a hundred and fifty dollars to a stranger.

lines.text: Floorwalker checks every refund and payout an AI agent makes through PayPal.
Maya's mug arrived chipped. The support agent refunds $24.
lines.spoken: Maya's mug arrived chipped. The support agent refunds twenty-four dollars.

lines.text: Floorwalker checks PayPal's own records and the owner's rules,
an AI review agrees, and the refund goes through in the PayPal sandbox.
Daniel's bowl came in the wrong colour: $86, above the agent's limit.
lines.spoken: Daniel's bowl came in the wrong colour: eighty-six dollars, above the agent's limit.

lines.text: So it waits for Elena. Her phone shows the request, the facts and the reason.
One tap runs exactly that refund, once.
This email hides instructions for the agent.
The AI review quotes them, and nothing reaches PayPal.
A hijacked agent tries six money moves. Every one is stopped.
Elena approves every refund between $40 and $60, and declined one at $72.
lines.spoken: Elena approves every refund between forty and sixty dollars, and declined one at seventy-two.

lines.text: So Floorwalker offers to stop asking.
Demo history replay: her taps drop from 55 to 41 per 100.
lines.spoken: Demo history replay: her taps drop from fifty-five to forty-one per hundred.

lines.text: Nothing she declined would pass, and the budget and checks stay in force.
One click approves Tessa and updates the rule.
Floorwalker can only stop money that goes through it, so it also watches PayPal.
A $25 refund made straight through the PayPal API
lines.spoken: A twenty-five dollar refund made straight through the PayPal API

lines.text: is caught within seconds, and the agents are paused until Elena says whether it was her.
Every decision lands in the ledger.
Elena groups what was stopped by agent, opens the evidence behind any decision, charts it and exports the record.
Bring your own agent: give it a key and its own limits, and it calls Floorwalker over REST or MCP instead of PayPal.
On 198 labelled cases with 80 attacks, an agent with no guard let $3,796 of attacks through.
lines.spoken: On a hundred and ninety-eight labelled cases with eighty attacks, an agent with no guard let three thousand, seven hundred and ninety-six dollars of attacks through.

lines.text: Giving the model the rules let $52 through and asked the owner 49 times per 100 money moves.
lines.spoken: Giving the model the rules let fifty-two dollars through and asked the owner forty-nine times per hundred money moves.

lines.text: Floorwalker let nothing through, and asked 30 times.
lines.spoken: Floorwalker let nothing through, and asked thirty times.

lines.text: Floorwalker. Every refund checked. Fewer taps as it learns. Try it live at floorwalker.yingzhilu.cn.
lines.spoken: Floorwalker. Every refund checked. Fewer taps as it learns. Try it live at floorwalker dot yingzhilu dot C N.
